title: Wayfarer
description: Walk your freighter, work with your crew, and fly cargo between frontier ports and an asteroid outpost.
imageAlt: Wayfarer at Cinder Quay, with the captain, crew, freight terminal, and the freighter ramp.
note: Complete standalone Sites v30 game recovered from commit eacc6f34d17d6d5e7584504188e59b4573a940b1. Runs directly on GitHub Pages without sign-in or external game assets. All 30 source commits are preserved in history/source-history.bundle. Existing Sites saves stay at the original origin.

title: Silt + Signal
description: A hand-drawn survival RPG. Scavenge, fight, and rebuild a life from almost nothing.
imageAlt: Silt + Signal gameplay in the Drowned Mile, with the survivor beside a stranded bus and flooded landscape.
note: Complete standalone Sites v3 game recovered from commit 9f2fcf390a0da78f054fd87bdc5259a3560098d0. Runs directly on GitHub Pages without sign-in or external game assets. All 3 source commits are preserved in history/source-history.bundle. Existing Sites saves stay at the original origin. Preview captured from the public v3 game on September 27, 2026.

title: First Light
description: Build an interstellar civilization on miniature planets. Connect cargo routes, develop local industries, and watch homes and market streets grow.
imageAlt: First Light: the growing town at Longshore Bay, cargo drones, a clay brickworks, and a tile inspector identifying the founding ship and buildings.
note: Ground into Towns: self-contained portable release with editable source and tests. Screenshot captured from the same v0.9 source in compatibility rendering. Existing Sites saves can be transferred with Export save / Import save.

title: PETRI: Living Lineages
description: A living pond of evolving organisms. Inspect their anatomy, inherited genes, and family histories.
imageAlt: PETRI pond with organism populations and a Mixo anatomy inspector.
note: Recovered v05 web app and v01–v04 releases from the ChatGPT project files. The main entry is the v05 web build. Download the complete modular source from `downloads/`. See [QA notes](QA.md) for prior validation and device limitations. The screenshot is the supplied v05 release capture. The web manifest and service worker use relative scope, so this app is contained within `/petri/living-lineages/`.

title: Inkdrift
description: Pilot a small cartoon ship through a procedural asteroid field and land on illustrated worlds.
imageAlt: Inkdrift spacecraft among asteroids in a blue and purple starfield.
note: Current standalone Inkdrift demo. Inkstar is the early generation, preserved under archive/inkstar/. Old Inkstar entry URLs redirect to the corresponding archived builds. The current Inkdrift runtime is unchanged.

title: Petri Classic
description: The original petri-dish experiments in population, diet, evolving traits, and radiation.
imageAlt: Green colonies and multicolored organisms in the classic Petri simulation.
note: `index.html` is the original freeze 09 scalar file, unchanged. Earlier freezes are under `versions/`. Root-level historical HTML addresses redirect to their corresponding preserved builds. Preview captured from the same original scalar build on 2026-09-26.

title: Radio chatter
description: Simulated radio conversations with synthesized voices, environmental context, and experimental local language models.
imageAlt: Radio chatter interface with start and stop controls and a generated Bravo transmission.
note: The recommended start is scripted `versions/tts_09.html`. All original snapshots live under `versions/`, and their old root URLs redirect to them. Language-model variants retain their original CDN/model dependencies; they have not been revalidated. Preview captured from tts_09 on 2026-09-27.

title: Planetside
description: A procedural planet workbench with terrain, grid, lighting, and rendering controls.
note: The repository root is this single project’s directory. The original runtime is unchanged. WebGL is required; a working graphics screenshot is still pending because the capture browser cannot create a WebGL context.

title: Planet generator
description: Build Earthlike worlds with procedural terrain, starfields, and several rendering experiments.
note: The repository root is this project’s directory. Current build: `index.html`; earlier builds: `versions/`. Original launch URLs redirect to their versions. Requires WebGL and external graphics modules. Some historical module URLs may need repair; runtime behavior is unchanged. Screenshot pending.

title: Starmap
description: Explore a procedural field of stars and configure the planetary systems around them.
note: The repository root is this single project’s directory. `starmap_001_frz_2.html` is the unchanged runtime. Requires WebGL and external Three.js modules. A working graphics screenshot is pending.

title: Orbital Velocity
description: A top-down spaceflight experiment built around thrust, gravity, and orbital motion.
note: The repository root is this single project’s directory. `index.html` is unchanged. A working graphics screenshot is pending: this capture browser lacks the WebGL context requested by the game. Gameplay has not been revalidated.

title: Ship effects
description: A focused spacecraft study: layered hull plates, thrusters, laser fire, and landing legs.
note: Moved unchanged from `spaceship_001.html`, which now redirects here. Requires WebGL and an external Three.js module. A working graphics screenshot is pending.

title: ASCII FLIP
description: A colored particle and fluid experiment rendered as a moving field of ASCII characters.
note: Recovered unchanged from `ascii_flip.html` at commit `3397305bc1c1f6d147a70f58febc5879a0caa5e6`. This is distinct from the later sphere files. It uses Three.js/WebGL before conversion to ASCII; a working screenshot is pending.

title: Pulsating sphere
description: A small Three.js animation study in changing color, size, and motion.
note: `index.html` is the original `sphere.html`. The byte-identical historical `ascii_flip.html` remains in `versions/`; both old root launch URLs redirect here. Requires WebGL. A working screenshot is pending.
